headlines.title: Bolsonaro and Lula head to runoff: 5 takeaways from Brazil’s election
headlines.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva finished first and second in the opening round of Brazil’s presidential election. They'll meet in a runoff on Oct. 25.

headlines.title: Israel orders security review of incoming flights after co-pilot attack
headlines.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called for a review of “all aspects” of security of foreign civil flights to Israel.

headlines.title: U.S. Marine accused of killing woman in Japan, drawing official protest from Tokyo
headlines.summary: Devin Jacob Ballard was arrested in the killing and robbing of Anna Yagi, police told Japan’s public broadcaster. He denied the allegations, a spokesman said.

headlines.title: U.S. shipwreck, laden with World War II munitions, is a time bomb near London
headlines.summary: A salvage crew has been working to stabilize the SS Richard Montgomery, which sank a few months after D-Day in 1944 with 1,500 tons of explosives in its holds.

headlines.title: FlyDubai co-pilot used crash ax to attempt terrorist act, UAE says
headlines.summary: The alleged attacker, Hamam al-Hammami, had been banned from flying with Oman Air because of concerns about his radical views, a person familiar with the matter said.

headlines.title: Fighting intensifies in Yemen as Iran says ‘no military solution’ to US war
headlines.summary: Yemeni government announces major offensive against Houthis, as Iran says it is ready to defend itself if US attacks.

headlines.title: Brazil’s presidential race: Three key takeaways from the first round
headlines.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro beat polling expectations as Brazil’s right gained ground, setting up October 25 run-off with Lula.

headlines.title: Nearly 1,500 migrants arrive in Myanmar from Malaysia despite UN warnings
headlines.summary: Malaysia continues mass refugee deportations despite warnings from the UN about unsafe conditions in an active war zone.

headlines.title: Four African leaders issue joint declaration as Ethiopia war escalates
headlines.summary: Egyptian, Eritrean, Somali and Sudanese leaders also call for talks to end the civil war in Sudan.

headlines.title: US coastguard suspends search for six on board crashed medical jet

headlines.title: Brazil's presidential race heads to Lula–Bolsonaro run-off as right gains ground
headlines.summary: Now there are two: Brazil heads into a runoff after a first round that failed to fully energize voters, setting the stage for a more polarized contest that Washington is watching very closely.

headlines.title: Brazil votes, with Lula facing Bolsonaro's son
headlines.summary: In Brazil, President Lula da Silva faces Flávio Bolsonaro, son of the jailed former president, in a tight race. If neither wins more than half the votes they'll face each other again on Oct. 25.

headlines.title: Trump names national intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
headlines.summary: Trump said Clayton will lead the White House's new "Super Intelligence Force," which will coordinate government engagement with artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Cornell president calls gang rape allegations 'deeply disturbing'
headlines.summary: Cornell president Michael I. Kotlikoff said his university "must do better" in a video statement. "This is a defining moment in Cornell's history," he added.

headlines.title: U.S. Marine arrested for alleged murder of a woman in Okinawa, Japan
headlines.summary: Japanese police arrested a U.S. Marine in the alleged robbery and murder of a woman on Okinawa, officials said Sunday.

headlines.title: Washington blames UK base incident on a 'foreign actor'
headlines.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the "hands of a foreign actor" were involved in an incident in which five men were arrested on suspected explosives and terrorism offenses near a British air base used by US forces.

headlines.title: Chancay Port rides a new trade current
headlines.summary: For Santos Javier Gonzales, the deep-water mega port taking shape in his hometown of Chancay, Peru, has become part of his own story — enabling him to build a career without leaving his family behind.

headlines.title: Landmark Chinese garden takes root in England
headlines.summary: SALFORD, England — After nearly eight years in the making, a Chinese garden that authorities describe as the largest of its kind in Europe has opened in Salford, bringing a distinctive Chinese presence to the horticultural landscape of northern England.

headlines.title: Ukraine's provocations fuel tensions, Putin says
headlines.summary: MOSCOW/KYIV — Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Friday that an escalation of tensions would not achieve the outcome sought by Kyiv and could only worsen the situation in Ukraine.

headlines.title: Japan protests to US over alleged robbery-murder by Marine in Okinawa
headlines.summary: TOKYO - A 20-year-old US Marine stationed in Japan's southernmost prefecture of Okinawa was arrested by local police on Sunday on suspicion of robbing and murdering a woman, local media reported.
